text.p: Many newspapers did not come out on Monday, the eve of Orthodox Chrismas
- Russian emergency experts say that an oil spill from a sunken Russian tanker near Japan is not likely to turn into an ecological disaster.
- The Russian motorised brigade No.205, pulled out of Chechnya, faces hardships at its new base, the town of Budennovsk in southern Russia.
- Millions of Russians are unable to survive without free medical care.
- Death rate in the Russian army, not linked to combat action, is very high.
